name: Cote d'Ivoire
headline: Cote d'Ivoire: +6.5% growth in 2025, 0.1% inflation, debt 57% of GDP
sections: Cote d'Ivoire is a $99.9 billion economy (2025), the world's 80th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +6.5% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $8,209 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 12.3% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 0.1% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 5.2% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 2.3% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 4.0% (2025).
Gross government debt is 57% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has risen from 46% in 2020. The general government balance is −3.0% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −0.6% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 55% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.0% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 51% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 62.1 years (2024). Population: 32.9 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
